verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a document-processing service. The evidence never documents any retention setting or any way to delete uploaded or processed data. The API can delete workflows and source connectors, and the product cites dedicated-instance data isolation and GDPR compliance, but these are adjacent controls, not user-controllable retention or deletion of data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
